Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray reveals sharply demarcated, thin-walled cystic cavities with air-fluid levels located in the left lower lobe (retrocardiac region), which is a classic radiographic presentation of an infected intralobar pulmonary sequestration. Other options are inconsistent with the specific location (right upper lobe) or morphology (emphysema, TB, edema) of the lesions shown.
